caseTitle.zh: 急診：從非洲回來的發燒
caseTitle.en: ER: a fever that flew home from Africa

condition.zh: 旅遊醫學 · 境外移入瘧疾

title.en: Infectious diseases: an evening of ER consults

tagline.zh: 從瘧疾流行區回來發燒，就是瘧疾，直到證明不是
tagline.en: Fever after a malaria zone is malaria until proven otherwise

desc.zh: 問出 TOCC、私下問完整的暴露史、排除重症、決定送加護病房、通報、在半夜之前抓到一個會讓人昏迷的低血糖。
desc.en: Take the TOCC history, ask the full exposure history in private, look for severe disease, send him to intensive care, notify, and catch a hypoglycaemia that would have looked like coma before midnight.

desc.zh: 做厚片和薄片、染色、在顯微鏡下找到戒指一樣的寄生蟲、算寄生率、打危急值電話。
desc.en: Make the thick and thin films, stain them, find the ring-shaped parasites under the microscope, count the parasitaemia, and phone the critical value.

about.zh: 年輕時在非洲做過兩年醫療援助，辦公室牆上有一張蚊帳的照片。口頭禪：「從瘧疾流行區回來發燒，就是瘧疾，直到證明不是。」
about.en: Spent two years on medical aid in Africa when young; a photo of a mosquito net hangs in her office. Catchphrase: 'Fever after a malaria zone is malaria until proven otherwise.'

about.zh: 全院看瘧疾抹片最多的人。她的口訣是「厚片看有沒有，薄片看是誰」。
about.en: Has read more malaria films than anyone in the hospital. Her rule: 'The thick film says whether; the thin film says who.'

about.zh: 38 歲電廠工程師，在西非工地三個月，兩週前回台。預防藥吃了兩週就停了，「工地沒人在吃」。發燒、發冷、頭痛四天，今天眼白有點黃、愛睡。急診寫：類流感。（虛擬個案）
about.en: Thirty-eight, a power-plant engineer, three months on a site in West Africa, home two weeks ago. Stopped his preventive tablets after two weeks: 'nobody on site took them'. Four days of fever, chills and headache; today slightly yellow eyes and drowsy. ER note: influenza-like illness. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 國小老師，家裡有兩個小孩。第一個問題：「會不會傳染給小孩？」第二個問題她不敢問。
about.en: A primary-school teacher with two children at home. Her first question: 'Can the children catch it?' Her second, she dare not ask.

about.zh: 流感快篩做得很快，旅遊史問得比較慢。今晚之後會反過來。
about.en: Quick with a flu swab, slower with a travel history. After tonight it will be the other way round.

about.zh: 加護病房護理師，血糖照規定的時間測，一次都不會漏。
about.en: ICU nurse who checks the glucose exactly on schedule and never misses one.

about.zh: 接到瘧疾通報，會問他住在哪裡、附近有沒有積水，因為台灣還有瘧蚊。
about.en: On a malaria notification, asks where he lives and whether there is standing water nearby, because Taiwan still has Anopheles mosquitoes.

plain.zh: 由瘧蚊叮咬傳播的寄生蟲病，寄生蟲住進紅血球裡繁殖、再把紅血球撐破。台灣已經根除本土瘧疾，但每年都有從流行區帶回來的病例。
plain.en: A parasitic disease spread by mosquito bites; the parasite lives and multiplies inside red cells and bursts them. Taiwan eliminated local malaria, but imported cases arrive from endemic areas every year.

plain.zh: 最危險的一種瘧疾寄生蟲，非洲最常見。會讓紅血球黏在小血管裡，傷到腦、腎、肺，可以在幾天內致命。
plain.en: The most dangerous malaria parasite, commonest in Africa. It makes red cells stick in small vessels and injures brain, kidneys and lungs, and can kill within days.

plain.zh: 發燒病人的四個問題：旅遊史、職業、接觸史、身邊有沒有人一起生病。台灣的醫院急診每個人都會問。
plain.en: Four questions for a fever: Travel, Occupation, Contact, Cluster. Asked of everyone in Taiwanese emergency departments.

plain.zh: 一大滴血塗厚、不固定，染色時紅血球破掉，寄生蟲集中在一起。用來找「有沒有」。
plain.en: A large drop spread thickly and left unfixed so the red cells burst in the stain and the parasites concentrate. Used to find whether parasites are there.

plain.zh: 像一般血液抹片一樣推薄、用甲醇固定，紅血球完整。用來看是哪一種寄生蟲、算有多少比例的紅血球被感染。
plain.en: Spread thin like an ordinary blood film and fixed in methanol, red cells intact. Used to name the species and count what fraction of red cells are infected.

plain.zh: 瘧疾抹片的標準染色。寄生蟲的細胞核染成紅紫色，細胞質染成藍色，看起來像一枚小戒指。
plain.en: The standard stain for malaria films. The parasite's nucleus turns red-purple and its cytoplasm blue, so it looks like a tiny ring.

plain.zh: 被寄生蟲感染的紅血球佔多少比例。越高越危險，治療後也用它看寄生蟲有沒有在減少。
plain.en: The proportion of red cells infected. The higher it is, the more dangerous; after treatment it shows whether the parasites are falling.

plain.zh: 有器官受影響的瘧疾：意識改變、抽搐、黃疸、腎衰竭、喘、休克、低血糖、嚴重貧血或寄生率很高。要住加護病房、依規範靜脈治療。
plain.en: Malaria with organs affected: altered consciousness, seizures, jaundice, kidney failure, breathlessness, shock, hypoglycaemia, severe anaemia or very high parasitaemia. It needs intensive care and intravenous treatment per protocol.

plain.zh: 去瘧疾流行區前、中、後吃的預防藥。要照醫師說的時間吃完，包括回國後那一段，自己提早停就失去保護。
plain.en: Preventive tablets taken before, during and after a trip to a malaria area. They must be finished as prescribed, including the stretch after coming home; stopping early removes the protection.

plain.zh: 法律規定醫師診斷後要在時限內通報衛生單位的傳染病。瘧疾是其中之一，讓衛生局可以防止本土傳播。
plain.en: An infection doctors are legally required to report to public health within a set time. Malaria is one, so the health bureau can prevent local spread.

plain.zh: 會傳播瘧疾的那一種蚊子。台灣現在還找得到，所以病人住院時要防蚊，避免被叮了再傳給別人。
plain.en: The kind of mosquito that carries malaria. It still exists in Taiwan, so patients are protected from bites in hospital to stop onward spread.

plain.zh: 脾臟變大。瘧疾時脾臟忙著清除被感染的紅血球而腫大、變脆，撞擊時可能破裂。
plain.en: An enlarged spleen. In malaria it swells, and becomes fragile, while clearing infected red cells, and a blow can rupture it.

plain.zh: 血糖太低。重症瘧疾和部分治療都會造成，症狀很容易被當成「瘧疾讓人昏睡」，所以要定時測。
plain.en: Blood glucose too low. Severe malaria and some treatments cause it, and it is easily mistaken for 'malaria making him drowsy', so it is checked on a schedule.

text.zh: 油鏡下找紅血球裡的小戒指。熱帶型瘧原蟲的線索：一個紅血球裡好幾枚戒指、香蕉形的配子體、很多紅血球同時被感染。
text.en: Under oil immersion, look for tiny rings inside red cells. Clues to falciparum: several rings in one cell, banana-shaped gametocytes, many cells infected at once.

text.zh: 看脾臟大小、肝臟、膽囊、有沒有腹水和肺部的水。瘧疾病人做超音波時探頭要輕，腫大的脾臟比平常脆。
text.en: Spleen size, liver, gallbladder, any free fluid, any fluid in the lungs. Press gently in malaria; an enlarged spleen is more fragile than usual.

text.zh: 重症瘧疾的監視器之外，還要一台血糖機和一個會叫醒病人問問題的人。昏睡不一定是腦，可能是糖。
text.en: Severe malaria needs, besides the monitor, a glucose meter and someone who wakes the patient to ask questions. Drowsiness may not be the brain; it may be the sugar.

text.zh: 瘧疾不會人傳人，但會「人傳蚊、蚊傳人」。在台灣，境外移入的病人住院時要防蚊：紗窗、蚊帳、防蚊液，避免在醫院附近產生本土病例。
text.en: Malaria does not pass person to person, but it does pass person to mosquito to person. In Taiwan imported cases are protected from bites in hospital, with screens, a bed net and repellent, so no local case starts near the hospital.

text.zh: 阿德行李箱裡找到的藥盒，鋁箔只剝了前兩排。工地的同事都沒在吃，他也就停了。這個盒子，是今晚所有事情的起點。
text.en: Found in De's suitcase, only the first two rows popped. Nobody on site took theirs, so he stopped too. This box is where tonight began.

text.zh: 旅遊史、職業、接觸史、群聚。從瘧疾流行區回來、幾個月內發燒，不管快篩怎麼說，都要當天驗瘧疾抹片；一次陰性不夠，要間隔重複。同時想著其他旅遊相關的感染：登革熱、傷寒、立克次體、急性愛滋病毒感染。
text.en: Travel, occupation, contact, cluster. Fever within months of returning from a malaria area means a malaria film that day, whatever the flu swab says; one negative film is not enough, so they are repeated at intervals. Keep the other travel infections in mind too: dengue, typhoid, rickettsia, acute HIV.

name.zh: 厚片看有沒有，薄片看是誰
name.en: Thick says whether, thin says who

text.zh: 厚片把很多血集中在一起，敏感度高，用來確定有沒有寄生蟲；不固定，讓紅血球破掉。薄片推薄、甲醇固定，紅血球完整，用來分種類、算寄生率。兩張都要，再加上抗原快篩當輔助。種類和寄生率決定要不要當重症處理。
text.en: The thick film concentrates a lot of blood, so it is sensitive, for deciding whether parasites are present; it is left unfixed so red cells burst. The thin film is spread thin and fixed in methanol, cells intact, for naming the species and counting parasitaemia. Both are needed, with a rapid antigen test as support. Species and parasitaemia decide whether to treat as severe.

text.zh: 意識改變、抽搐、虛弱到站不起來、黃疸、尿少、喘、休克、出血、低血糖、嚴重貧血、寄生率高。有任何一項，就是重症：加護病房、依規範靜脈治療、定時測血糖、重複抹片追寄生率、通報。熱帶型瘧原蟲可以在一天之內從「類流感」變成昏迷。
text.en: Altered consciousness, seizures, too weak to stand, jaundice, little urine, breathlessness, shock, bleeding, hypoglycaemia, severe anaemia, high parasitaemia. Any one means severe: intensive care, intravenous treatment per protocol, scheduled glucose checks, repeat films to follow the parasitaemia, notification. Falciparum can turn 'flu-like illness' into coma within a day.

note.zh: TOCC：西非三個月，預防藥停了
note.en: TOCC: three months in West Africa, prophylaxis stopped

sub.zh: 發燒四天，流感快篩陰性，剛從非洲回來
sub.en: Four days of fever, flu swab negative, just back from Africa

lines.zh: 阿文。8 床阿德，38 歲，發燒四天，流感快篩陰性。我本來要讓他回家，護理師說他兩週前從非洲回來。
lines.en: Wen. Bed 8, De, 38, four days of fever, flu swab negative. I was going to send him home, but the nurse says he got back from Africa two weeks ago.

lines.zh: （電話）嚴主治。從瘧疾流行區回來發燒，就是瘧疾，直到證明不是。先不要讓他走。抹片現在做。
lines.en: (On the phone) Dr Yan. Fever after a malaria zone is malaria until proven otherwise. Do not let him go. Films now.

lines.zh: ……好。我以後先問旅遊史，再拿快篩。
lines.en: ...Right. From now on, travel history first, swab second.

guide.en: Take the TOCC history at bed 8

lines.zh: 在西非電廠工地三個月。預防藥吃了兩週，工地沒人在吃，我就停了。蚊子很多，晚上都在外面喝啤酒。
lines.en: Three months on a power-plant site in West Africa. Took the preventive tablets two weeks; nobody on site took them, so I stopped. Plenty of mosquitoes; we drank beer outside every evening.

lines.zh: 阿德，我接下來想私下問幾個問題，太太可以先在外面等一下嗎？這是每個旅行回來發燒的人都會問的。
lines.en: De, I'd like to ask a few questions in private. Could your wife wait outside a moment? We ask everyone who comes back from a trip with a fever.

lines.zh: ……有一次，跟當地的人。沒有用保險套。我很怕，可是不敢說。
lines.en: ...Once, with someone local. No condom. I've been scared, but didn't dare say.

post.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。這會保密。日期記下來了，愛滋病毒的檢查用對的種類、在對的時間做。
post.en: Thank you for telling me. It stays confidential. I've noted the date; the HIV test will be the right type at the right time.

post.zh: 不帶評價地問、私下問、記清楚日期和檢驗種類。今晚最急的還是瘧疾，但這一題不能漏。
post.en: Ask without judgement, in private, and record the date and the type of test. Malaria is tonight's emergency, but this question must not be missed.

note.zh: 戒指形寄生蟲，一個紅血球裡好幾枚
note.en: Ring forms, several to a cell

guide.en: Hand hygiene before the blood draw

lines.zh: 瘧疾不會人傳人，但會經過血傳。抽血、推片之前，手部衛生、手套，針不回套。
lines.en: Malaria doesn't pass person to person, but it does pass through blood. Before drawing and spreading: hand hygiene, gloves, no recapping.

post.zh: 好。不用等他發燒才抽，瘧疾抹片什麼時候抽都可以，越早越好。
post.en: Good. No need to wait for a fever spike: a malaria film can be drawn at any time, and sooner is better.

guide.en: Make the malaria films in order

lines.zh: 小綾的口訣：厚片看有沒有，薄片看是誰。順序錯了，厚片被固定就白做了。
lines.en: Ling's rule: the thick film says whether, the thin film says who. Get the order wrong and fix the thick film by mistake, and it's wasted.

q.en: Malaria films: put the steps in order

steps.zh: 核對病人，採血不必等發燒
steps.en: Check the patient; draw without waiting for fever

steps.zh: 同一張或兩張玻片做厚片與薄片
steps.en: Prepare a thick and a thin film
Fix only the thin film in methanol

steps.zh: 厚片找寄生蟲，薄片判種類
steps.en: Thick: find parasites; thin: name the species

guide.en: Find the rings under the microscope

lines.zh: 厚片先看：滿滿的小點。換薄片：紅血球裡的小戒指，你看這一顆，裡面有兩枚。
lines.en: Thick film first: dots everywhere. Now the thin film: tiny rings inside the red cells. Look at this one, two rings in a single cell.

lines.zh: 還有一個香蕉形的……配子體？很多紅血球同時被感染。這是熱帶型瘧原蟲。
lines.en: And a banana shape... a gametocyte? Lots of cells infected at once. This is Plasmodium falciparum.

lines.zh: 對。寄生率算出來很高。這是危急值，你打電話，我核對。
lines.en: Yes. The parasitaemia comes out high. That's a critical value: you phone, I'll double-check.

note.zh: 熱帶型瘧原蟲，重症：送加護病房

guide.en: Take the critical value and read back

sub.zh: 8 床阿德：瘧疾抹片陽性，請複誦
sub.en: Bed 8, De: malaria film positive; read back

lines.zh: 小綾。8 床阿德，瘧疾抹片陽性，熱帶型瘧原蟲，寄生率高。抗原快篩也陽性。請複誦。
lines.en: Ling. Bed 8, De: malaria film positive, Plasmodium falciparum, high parasitaemia. Rapid antigen test also positive. Please read back.

lines.zh: 複誦：8 床，熱帶型瘧原蟲，寄生率高，快篩陽性。收到，時間記了。
lines.en: Reading back: bed 8, falciparum, high parasitaemia, rapid test positive. Received, time recorded.

guide.en: Phone the critical value to the doctor

lines.zh: 醫檢師報危急值：急診 8 床阿德，熱帶型瘧原蟲，寄生率高。請複誦。
lines.en: Technologist with a critical value: ER bed 8, De, Plasmodium falciparum, high parasitaemia. Please read back.

lines.zh: 複誦完成。謝謝妳，這麼快看出來的片子，可能救了一個人。
lines.en: Read back. Thank you; a film read this quickly may have saved a life.

lines.zh: 阿德的眼白黃了，叫他要叫兩次才睜眼。他說頭好重，想睡。
lines.en: De's eyes are yellow, and he opens them only on the second call. He says his head is heavy and he wants to sleep.

q.zh: 熱帶型瘧原蟲、寄生率高、黃疸、嗜睡。你怎麼處理？
q.en: Falciparum, high parasitaemia, jaundice, drowsiness. What do you do?

options.zh: 重症：加護病房、依規範靜脈治療、通報
options.en: Severe: ICU, intravenous treatment per protocol, notify

why.zh: 黃疸、意識改變、寄生率高，任何一項都是重症瘧疾。加護病房、依規範靜脈治療、定時測血糖、重複抹片，並依規定通報衛生單位。
why.en: Jaundice, altered consciousness, high parasitaemia: any one is severe malaria. ICU, intravenous treatment per protocol, scheduled glucose checks, repeat films, and notification to public health as required.

options.zh: 口服藥治療，明天門診追蹤

why.zh: 口服治療是給沒有重症徵象的人。他已經黃疸、嗜睡，熱帶型可以在一天之內變成昏迷。
why.en: Oral treatment is for people without severe features. He is already jaundiced and drowsy, and falciparum can become coma within a day.

options.zh: 等明天再一次抹片確認種類
options.en: Wait for tomorrow's repeat film to confirm the species

why.zh: 種類已經確定，重症徵象已經出現。重複抹片是用來追蹤治療反應，不是延後治療的理由。
why.en: The species is confirmed and severe features are present. Repeat films track the response to treatment; they are not a reason to delay it.

post.zh: 靜脈治療的藥依規範向藥局調來了。加護病房我打過電話，床有。
post.en: The intravenous treatment is on its way from pharmacy per protocol. I've called ICU; they have a bed.

note.zh: 脾臟腫大；其他旅遊感染不能忘
note.en: Splenomegaly; the other travel infections stay on the list

guide.en: Scan the abdomen at the bedside

lines.zh: 探頭輕一點。告訴我脾臟的大小，還有為什麼它跟阿德出院後的生活有關。
lines.en: Gently with the probe. Tell me the spleen size, and why it matters for De's life after discharge.

question.zh: 瘧疾病人做上腹部超音波，要看哪些東西？為什麼脾臟腫大要特別交代？
question.en: In a malaria patient, what does the upper-abdominal ultrasound look for, and why does an enlarged spleen need special advice?

answer.zh: 看脾臟和肝臟大小、膽囊、腹水、肋膜積水，也幫忙排除其他造成黃疸或腹痛的原因。瘧疾的脾臟腫大又脆，撞擊可能破裂，所以恢復期一段時間內要避免激烈碰撞的運動，突然左上腹痛或頭暈要馬上回來。
answer.en: Spleen and liver size, the gallbladder, free fluid and pleural effusions, and other causes of jaundice or abdominal pain. A malarial spleen is enlarged and fragile and can rupture with a blow, so contact sports are avoided for a while during recovery, and sudden left upper abdominal pain or dizziness means come back at once.

post.zh: 脾臟腫大，肝臟稍大，沒有腹水。膽囊正常，黃疸比較像紅血球破掉造成的。
post.en: Splenomegaly, liver slightly enlarged, no free fluid. Gallbladder normal; the jaundice looks like it comes from bursting red cells.

guide.en: Work through the differential with the mentor

lines.zh: 瘧疾確定了，但一個人可以同時有兩個問題。旅行回來發燒，你清單上還有誰？
lines.en: Malaria is confirmed, but one person can have two problems. Fever after travel: who else is on your list?

post.zh: 登革熱、傷寒、立克次體，還有急性愛滋病毒感染。症狀不等於確診，照檢驗流程一個一個排除。
post.en: Dengue, typhoid, rickettsia, and acute HIV infection. Symptoms are not a diagnosis; we exclude each through the proper test pathway.

post.zh: 血液培養已經送了，愛滋病毒依暴露日期選對的檢驗。好。
post.en: Blood cultures are sent, and the HIV test chosen to suit the exposure date. Good.

note.en: Not person to person; notification and bite protection

lines.zh: 醫師，會不會傳染給小孩？他昨天還抱著小的睡覺。
lines.en: Doctor, can the children catch it? He slept holding our youngest last night.

lines.zh: 瘧疾不會人傳人，抱、親、一起吃飯都不會。它要靠瘧蚊叮了病人，再去叮別人。
lines.en: Malaria doesn't pass from person to person: hugs, kisses, shared meals are all fine. It needs an Anopheles mosquito to bite him and then bite someone else.

lines.zh: 台灣還有瘧蚊，所以他住院時會在蚊帳裡，我們也會通報衛生局，他們會去家附近看看。
lines.en: Taiwan still has those mosquitoes, so in hospital he'll be under a bed net, and we'll notify the health bureau, who will check around your home.

lines.zh: 那他……會不會死？
lines.en: Then... will he die?

lines.zh: 這是重症，我不會騙妳。但我們抓得早，今晚就開始最好的治療，加護病房會一直看著他。
lines.en: It's severe, and I won't lie to you. But we caught it early, the best treatment starts tonight, and intensive care will watch him all the time.

sub.zh: 收到瘧疾通報，想確認旅遊史

lines.zh: 衛生局。收到你們的瘧疾通報。他回國後去過哪裡？住家附近有沒有水溝、積水？同行的工地同事名單有嗎？
lines.en: Health bureau. We've received your malaria notification. Where has he been since returning? Any ditches or standing water near home? A list of his site colleagues?

lines.zh: 回國後大多在家。同事名單他太太會整理。工地同事也都沒吃預防藥，請你們一起提醒。
lines.en: Mostly at home since getting back. His wife will put together the colleague list. None of them took prophylaxis either; please remind them too.

lines.zh: 法定傳染病通報不是填表，是在保護下一個人。
lines.en: Reporting a notifiable disease is not paperwork. It protects the next person.

note.en: Drowsy: not the brain, the sugar

sub.zh: 阿德定時血糖偏低，比較叫不醒
sub.en: De's scheduled glucose is low; harder to rouse

lines.zh: 阿蘋。阿德靜脈治療開始了。剛剛定時測的血糖偏低，他比一小時前難叫醒，冒汗。
lines.en: Ping. De's intravenous treatment is running. The scheduled glucose just came back low, he's harder to rouse than an hour ago, and sweaty.

lines.zh: 醫師！他在觀察區叫不醒，一直冒汗，講話亂七八糟。護理師剛剛還說他只是睏。
lines.en: Doctor! He won't wake up in the observation area, he's sweating and talking nonsense. The nurse said he was only sleepy.

lines.zh: 沒有定時血糖，這段時間就沒人看著。現在測，然後他直接上加護病房。
lines.en: With no scheduled glucose checks, nobody was watching this. Check it now, and he goes straight up to ICU.

lines.zh: 阿德皺著眉，叫他的名字只會哼一聲。血糖機的數字很低。
lines.en: De frowns and only grunts at his name. The glucose meter reads low.

options.zh: 意識不清不能吞：依規範靜脈給糖並重測
options.en: Too drowsy to swallow: IV glucose per protocol, then recheck

why.zh: 重症瘧疾本身和部分治療都會造成低血糖，症狀跟腦部瘧疾很像。意識不清不能口服，依規範靜脈給糖、重測，之後縮短測血糖的間隔。
why.en: Severe malaria and some of its treatments both cause hypoglycaemia, and it mimics cerebral malaria. Someone this drowsy cannot take sugar by mouth: intravenous glucose per protocol, recheck, then check more often.

options.zh: 腦部瘧疾，先排腦部斷層
options.en: Cerebral malaria; get a head CT first

why.zh: 可能是，也可能只是糖。測得到、又治得好的原因要先處理，再去推床照片子。
why.en: It might be, or it might just be the sugar. Treat the measurable, treatable cause first, before wheeling him to the scanner.

options.en: Get him to drink sugar water

why.zh: 叫不醒的人不能從嘴巴餵，會嗆進肺裡。
why.en: Someone who cannot be roused must not be fed by mouth; it goes into the lungs.

post.zh: ……醫師？我剛剛夢到在工地喝啤酒。我老婆呢？
post.en: ...Doctor? I just dreamed I was drinking beer on site. Where's my wife?

post.zh: 醒了。昏睡不一定是腦，常常是糖。血糖改成更密集地測，寫在交班單第一行。
post.en: Awake. Drowsiness is not always the brain; often it's the sugar. Glucose checks more frequent from now, first line of the handover.

note.zh: 寄生率、血糖、通報、保密的那一題
note.en: Parasitaemia, glucose, notification, the private question

lines.zh: 8 床阿德：重症熱帶型瘧疾，靜脈治療依規範已開始。血糖密集監測，低血糖一次已處理。
lines.en: Bed 8, De: severe falciparum malaria, intravenous treatment started per protocol. Close glucose monitoring; one hypoglycaemia treated.

lines.zh: 明早重複抹片看寄生率是否下降。已通報衛生局，住院防蚊。另有一項保密檢驗依暴露日期安排。
lines.en: Repeat films in the morning to check the parasitaemia is falling. Health bureau notified; bite protection on the ward. One confidential test arranged to suit the exposure date.

lines.zh: 今晚他差一點以「類流感」回家。救他的不是快篩，是一個問了旅遊史的護理師。
lines.en: Tonight he nearly went home as 'flu-like illness'. What saved him wasn't a swab; it was a nurse who asked about travel.

lines.zh: 發燒先問 TOCC；厚片看有沒有、薄片看是誰；昏睡先測血糖；私下的問題，私下問。
lines.en: Fever: ask TOCC. Thick says whether, thin says who. Drowsy: check the sugar. Private questions, asked in private.

lines.zh: 還有，那盒預防性用藥，請他下次出國前拿來給我看。我幫他數。
lines.en: And that box of chemoprophylaxis: next time he travels, he brings it to me first. I'll count them for him.

lines.zh: （從加護病房打來）醫師，我太太說蚊帳很好睡。下次出差，我會把藥吃完。
lines.en: (Phoning from ICU) Doctor, my wife says the bed net is cosy. Next work trip, I'll finish the tablets.

sub.zh: 發燒先問 TOCC；昏睡先測血糖
sub.en: Fever: ask TOCC first; drowsy: check the sugar first
